name: Hall of the Brave
summary: Warriors gather and train in Orgrimmar's Hall of the Brave, in the Valley of Honor. The hall serves the Horde's front-line fighters, drillmasters, and battlemasters.

sections.title: The Warriors' Bastion
sections.body: The Hall of the Brave overlooks the Valley of Honor's waters and training rings. Veteran officers and seasoned warriors teach initiates melee combat, stances, and discipline. Training dummies and weapons line the hall. There, battlemasters organize combatants for major military engagements across Azeroth.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Hall of the Brave?
aliases: what is hall of the brave
faq.answer: The Hall of the Brave is Orgrimmar's main barracks and guild hall for warriors. Veteran trainers teach techniques, and practice dummies give warriors a place to hone their strikes. Battlemasters coordinate military deployments across contested lands.

faq.q: Where in Orgrimmar is the hall located?
aliases: where is hall of the brave
faq.answer: The Hall of the Brave sits on the eastern side of the Valley of Honor. It runs along the red canyon walls and overlooks the central pond.

faq.q: Who can be found inside the hall?
aliases: who is in hall of the brave
faq.answer: Warrior trainers and battlemasters can be found inside the hall. The battlemasters coordinate large military conflicts, while Horde grunts rest between patrols.

angles.text: As a warrior, you can train at the Hall of the Brave, your martial home in the capital. Its trainers teach advanced stances and battle maneuvers as your skill grows.
As a member of the Horde, you can see its front-line discipline at the Hall of the Brave. Battlemasters there muster troops to fight across the continent.
